fields.title: Find the transaction boundary
fields.inputs/0/label: After which step does the transaction boundary lie
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Checkout on Polka consists of seven steps. Mark where the transaction boundary lies and name the state the user will see if a failure occurs right after it.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: boundary between 5 and 6. Steps 1–5 are in a single database and a single transaction. Step 6 is an external system, no atomicity. A failure between 6 and 7 results in deducted money while the order status is "awaiting payment". The user should see "payment processing" rather than an error, because the money likely left. Rule of thumb: look for the first outward call — the boundary is always right before it.
